content: Xiaomi HyperOS/MIUI aggressively force-kills background apps; killing an app revokes its accessibility service silently and re-enabling shows a mandatory 10s warning dialog every time. Samsung One UI has 'sleeping/deep sleeping apps' lists. Oppo/Realme/OnePlus ColorOS/OxygenOS freeze background execution via Startup/Battery managers. Vivo similarly restricts background power. This is an industry-wide, well-documented problem (dontkillmyapp.com) requiring per-OEM onboarding guides plus a watchdog to detect and prompt re-enable.
